    • indicesValeursPropresTriees

      public int[] indicesValeursPropresTriees()
      Sorts the original indexes of the eigenvalues (the valeursPropres()' ones) according to the result of valeursPropresTriees() (descending order). The goal is to know which are the first eigenfaces we keep for the basis (these are the ones with the highest associated eigenvalues).
      Returns:
      The sorted indexes of the eigenvalues (the index of the highest one first and the index of the lower one last).
